title: Finding
description: A detected divergence between what a client says, what their mandate permits, and what they hold.

kind.description: D1 said-vs-held (spec 002), D2 mandate (spec 003), D3 hidden-when-split (spec 001), D4 plan-vs-runway (spec 004), D5 unanswered question (spec 004), D6 scenario (spec 005). Extended from D1-D4 by spec 004: implementation.md and RUN-SHEET.md both specified D5 and D6, and this schema already defines an `unanswered_question` object for D5, so only the enum had been left behind. See specs/004-liquidity-unanswered/research.md R6.

headline.description: One sentence, plain English, RM-facing. Must not contain 'recommend'.

detail.description: The reasoning. Names the person and their situation, not just the numbers.

evidence.description: Every claim must resolve to source rows.

events.description: event_log.csv ids only. The file is authoritative over model memory.

unsure_about.description: What would change this answer. Empty string if nothing. Drives the uncertainty screen.

classification.description: D2 only. Same breach, three different conversations. 'inherited' covers a transferred-in portfolio nobody chose — see findings.md section 2.

compliance_clean.description: True when every mandate band is respected and the finding still stands. The strongest case for the product: existing controls see nothing.

unanswered_question.description: A question the client asked in rm_notes.json with no recorded answer. FR-017.

opening_line.description: One sentence the RM could say aloud. The brief's worked example ends here; so does ours.
